title: Account
name: dev.uap.settlement.account
description: The commercial relationship between a participant and an exchange. Every party that pays or is paid has one.
$comment:
Cryptographic identity and commercial identity are separate in UAP. A signing key proves who sent a message; an account determines who gets billed or paid. A valid signature over a key with no account is trust tier 0: it can serve, and it can be paid on CPA, but it cannot sell CPM (SPEC.md §9.3).

One schema covers both sides because the lifecycle is the same. What differs is direction: an advertiser account accrues a payable, a payee account accrues a receivable.

entity_id.description: The participant this account belongs to.

kind.description: Which side of the ledger. `advertiser` pays in; the rest are paid out.

status.$comment:
pending_verification  submitted, not yet able to transact
  active                may serve or spend
  suspended             existing obligations stand; no new activity
  closed                settled and finished; an undisbursed balance is still owed

verification.description: What has been established about this entity, and therefore what it may do.

domain_verified.description: For advertisers: the brand manifest resolves and its domains check out.

tax_form.description: On file for payees. Required before disbursement in most jurisdictions.

trust_tier.description: The highest tier this entity has substantiated.

verification.$comment: Tier is a consequence of verification, not a claim. An account with `identity: none` cannot reach tier 1, so it cannot sell CPM, which is the whole reason enrolment is worth doing.

balance.description: Running position. Positive means owed to the account holder for a payee, owed by them for an advertiser.

pending_micros.description: Accrued from receipts not yet through the settlement window.

disbursed_micros.description: Paid out or collected to date.

spend_mandate.description: AP2 intent mandate authorising spend against this account.

credit.$comment: A prepay account cannot start a campaign whose budget exceeds its settled balance. Net terms require a credit decision the protocol does not make; it only records the outcome.

payout.description: Payee accounts only: where money goes and when.

handler_account_ref.description: Opaque reference held by the handler. UAP never carries payout credentials.

minimum_micros.description: Below this, payout rolls to the next period.

on_hold.description: Disbursement paused, usually pending tax documentation or a fraud review. The balance is still owed.
